caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statuette of a robed male figure with short brown hair and a beard, wearing a long brown robe tied at the waist with a sash, and standing on a rectangular pedestal. The figure is holding a child dressed in a bright red garment sitting on his left arm, with the child’s clothing accented by a light blue-gray collar and cuffs. The child’s hair is short and dark, and the feet are bare. The drawing includes three different views of the statuette: a front view occupying the center of the page, a right side view in the bottom left corner, and a rear view in the right lower quadrant. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white color. The main statue and its views are rendered with careful shading and detail, emphasizing the wood texture and coloration of the figures' garments and skin. The drawing is signed "E. Florenzzi - 1938" near the bottom.
title: Santo
